title: Cluster 04 — Knowledge Gap Drill (all of Book 1)
subtitle: H2 Biology 9477 · Book 1 · 8 questions · 114 marks · built from your Cluster 1, 2 and 3 transcripts
intro_html:
Every question here comes from something you actually got wrong, half-said, or reached the right answer by the wrong route. Nothing is generic revision. Forty-two gaps came out of your three drill transcripts, and eight questions cover thirty-nine of them; the other three belong to Books 3 and 4 and are flagged at the end.

Answers sit under each part, hidden. Say your full reasoning aloud before clicking. Where a part closes a specific gap, the answer names it, so you can see exactly what was missing last time.
